values.reopens: until further notice (bridge repair; no date)
values.note: FWP 'Site Closure - Partial' from 2025-12-23, until further notice: the Whitebird Creek bridge, the only public vehicle access, is unsafe for vehicular travel; the site stays open to walk-in users only.

status.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753880 (Special Notices & Closures, 'Site Closure - Partial': 'Due to damaged decking and substructure, the bridge spanning Whitebird creek leading to Whitebird FAS is unsafe for vehicular travel. This is the only public access to Whitebird FAS for motor vehicles. The site will remain open to walk-in users. FWP is identifying repair solutions and hopes to re-open the site to motor vehicles again. Until bridge repairs are completed the site will remain walk-in.' 2025-12-23 - Until further notice), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FAS camping $12/night with a valid fishing license, $18 without (the split is by fishing license, not residency). FWP's 2026 fee table gives $5 / $7.50 for MT residents 62+, disabled or veterans. The page also lists conservation licenses (MT resident $8, senior/youth $4, nonresident $10).

fees.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753880 (Facilities & Fees: 'FAS Camping Without Valid Fishing License 18.0', 'FAS Camping With Valid Fishing License 12.0') + https://fwp.mt.gov/binaries/content/assets/fwp/fish/fas/2026-fas-fee-table_adopted.pdf (as previously recorded), read 2026-10-22

booking.source: https://myfwp.mt.gov/fishMT/fas/39753880 (Restrictions: 'Stay Limit Maximum stay of 7 days'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: FWP lists a toilet (type not stated), primitive campsites and a gravel boat ramp (non-motorized boating); no drinking water listed.

note: Montana FWP fishing access site (23 acres, ~3,770 ft) on the Stillwater River with designated primitive camping (Region 5). Directions (FWP): 5.9 miles south of Columbus on Hwy 78. No trailer length limit published by FWP. --Claude
summary: FWP FishMT page: recorded a closure to vehicles (Whitebird Creek bridge unsafe, walk-in only since 2025-12-23, until further notice). Confirmed $12/$18 FAS camping, toilet, primitive campsites, gravel ramp; added the 7-day stay limit. Not stated: site count, trailer length, toilet type, how sites are taken (derived FCFS left), real season (placeholder only; stored manual year_round left). Note trimmed of restated facilities/fees/FCFS.
